items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Now there was a drummer, a real flashy drummer from New York and his name was Willie Jones... that's how I really got the gig there.

ctx.x: I had to play for them to see if I could do it -- I had to like audition. Now there was a drummer, a real flashy drummer from New York and his name was Willie Jones, you know, a real flashy drummer, you know, he wasn't a school drummer. And that was during the era of the Lindy Hoppers.
And so they had Lindy Hoppers traveling with them, and they just wanted to know if I could play 4/4 as fast as they wanted to dance, and that's how I really got the gig there.
